cpi.name: Consumer inflation (annual average)
cpi.method: Annual average y-o-y change in the Consumer Price Index. FY2021/22 to FY2025/26 verified against NRB figures (FY2021/22 and FY2022/23 as cited by ADB).

gdp.name: Real GDP growth
gdp.method: Annual % change in real GDP. FY2023/24 (3.67%, revised) and FY2024/25 (4.61%, estimate) are from NRB's FY2024/25 report; the preliminary FY2023/24 estimate was 3.87%. Earlier years are unverified.

rem.name: Remittance inflows
rem.method: Total workers' remittance inflow in NPR billions. 'verified' = value stated in an NRB release (FY2023/24, FY2025/26). 'derived' = back-calculated from NRB's reported growth rates (FY2022/23 and FY2021/22 from FY2023/24 growth of 16.5% and the prior year's 23.2%; FY2024/25 from FY2025/26 growth of 37.1%). Check against the NRB annual tables.

res.name: Gross foreign exchange reserves
res.method: Gross foreign exchange reserves in US$ bn from NRB releases: mid-July 2023, mid-July 2024, mid-July 2025. FY2025/26 is the mid-June 2026 figure (the annual mid-July 2026 US$ figure was not checked), so its date basis differs slightly.

td.name: Merchandise trade deficit
td.method: Imports minus exports of goods in NPR billions, from NRB annual macroeconomic reports. FY2022/23 is derived from the reported 1.0% fall in FY2023/24.

tou.name: Tourist arrivals
tou.publisher: Nepal Rastra Bank, citing Nepal Tourism Board
tou.method: International visitor arrivals from NRB annual reports (citing Nepal Tourism Board), converted to thousands.

pov.name: Population below national poverty line
pov.method: Share below the national poverty line, household surveys. 20.27% (NLSS 2022/23, reported by NSO) is verified; earlier survey values are unverified.

lit.name: Literacy rate (age 5+)
lit.method: Share of people aged 5+ able to read and write. Census 2021 (76.2%) verified; some outlets report 76.3%. Earlier censuses are unverified.

pop.name: Total population
pop.method: Enumerated population from the decennial census: 23,151,423 (2001), 26,494,504 (2011), 29,164,578 (2021).
